# Stable solutions per (front, side) view of the four visible (non-empty) tiles.
# A 'solution' is a distinct (triple, corner, double, single) 4-tuple for which
# at least one placement of the two empty tiles makes the tower stand.
#
# STRICT   = solutions that stand with a safety margin (no tile balances on a
#            support boundary). margin = 1e-4 cell-widths.
# MARGINAL = solutions that stand only when boundary balance is allowed
#            (some tile sits exactly on the edge of its support polygon).
# Total stable (permissive) = STRICT + MARGINAL.
#
# View grids: top row = z=2, rows separated by `|`, '#' = filled, '.' = empty.
# Format:  STRICT   MARGINAL   FRONT          SIDE
